name: migrate-components
goal: Migrate all view components and feature modules to use useTranslation(t) for all user-visible strings and add a locale toggle to the shell
design_constraints: Cook confirms unit-test and quality-gate choices before each phase
Each component's hardcoded English strings are replaced with t('key') calls
COMMON_TEXT, UI_TEXT, AUTH_TEXT constants remain as type-only references or are removed if no longer needed for non-UI logic
Do not change component structure or behavior — only swap static strings for t() calls
Locale toggle renders as a button near the theme toggle in the shell sidebar

steps.description: Update features/shell/StudentShell.tsx: replace all hardcoded strings ('Pearson', 'PTE Official AI Practice', 'Quick study', 'Search', 'Pearson PTE Core', 'Practice workspace', 'Student', 'Account') with t() calls. Add locale toggle button alongside the theme toggle. Wire it to useLocale().setLocale.
success_criteria: No hardcoded English strings remain in StudentShell.tsx
Locale toggle button is visible in the sidebar
Switching locale updates all shell labels

steps.description: Update features/home/HomeView.tsx: replace hardcoded strings ('Exam date:', 'Not scheduled', 'Recommended for you', 'Skills', 'View all', 'Workspace:') with t() calls. Strings from UI_TEXT that are already used should be replaced with t() equivalents.
success_criteria: All user-visible strings in HomeView use t() calls
Component renders correctly in both en and vi

steps.description: Update features/catalog/PracticeTestsView.tsx, CatalogGrid.tsx, CatalogCard.tsx, and SkillTaskList.tsx: replace hardcoded strings ('Practice library', 'Practice tests', 'Choose a skill...') and UI_TEXT references with t() calls.
success_criteria: All catalog feature components use t() for user-visible strings

steps.description: Update features/studyPack/StudyPackView.tsx: replace hardcoded strings ('Guided learning', 'Study-Pack', 'Keep related practice activities...', 'Open pack') and STUDY_PACKS text with t() calls. Move study pack titles/descriptions into locale dictionaries.
success_criteria: StudyPackView uses t() for all user-visible strings
Study pack titles and descriptions are translatable

steps.description: Update features/progress/ProgressView.tsx: replace all UI_TEXT.progress* references with t() calls.
success_criteria: All progress page strings use t() calls
Component renders correctly in both locales

steps.description: Update features/practice/PracticeSessionView.tsx: replace all UI_TEXT.session* and hardcoded strings with t() calls. This includes session overview, progress bar labels, confidence panel, footer actions, error states, and completion states.
success_criteria: All practice session strings use t() calls
Session overview, error, exited, and completed states are fully translated

steps.description: Update features/practice/AccessStatusBanner.tsx and ConfidenceHint.tsx: replace UI_TEXT references with t() calls.
success_criteria: AccessStatusBanner and ConfidenceHint use t() for all user-visible strings

steps.description: Update the auth sign-in page component (app/(auth)/sign-in/page.tsx or its feature component) to use t() for AUTH_TEXT strings (title, description, labels, buttons, error messages).
success_criteria: Auth page strings are translatable via t()
